note: Corrections, supersessions and retractions are appended, never deleted. Earlier documents and records remain published with a pointer to the correction. Retraction status of external studies has not been checked unless stated.

items.description: The F0-03.2 desk report predates extraction of the DWP Newham row. Local caseload figures are superseded by the NEW-02 source-verified extraction of the 2023/24 DWP model. The earlier report remains published with a supersession notice.

The 2026-11-06 public dataset registry lists the DWP local model licence as unknown. The later NEW-02 extraction (2026-11-09) recorded the publisher's OGL-3.0 statement for the ODS file. Knowledge-base facts use the later publisher statement with licence review status 'publisher statement recorded, no qualified review'. The registry entry is left unchanged as a dated historical record.
